en: Hey, champ in the making! Careful: the floor in here is lava, so you cross it on the stone slabs. Press the buttons on a slab to turn it or slide it.
Clair's Pokémon are dragons, and dragons shrug off most attacks. Ice moves are what they hate.
Clair's Pokémon are dragons, and dragons shrug off most attacks. Ice moves are what they hate. And mind the lava!
You beat Clair! Whatever she says, you're a real trainer already. I'd still do what she asks, though.
I am Clair, the finest master of Dragon-type Pokémon there is. I can stand up to the Elite Four themselves.
You still want to battle me? ...Fine. A Gym Leader holds nothing back, whoever comes. Here I come!
I won't accept this. I lost, yes, but you're still not ready for the Pokémon League.
I know. Take the dragon tamers' test. Behind this Gym is the Dragon's Den, and a shrine stands at its heart. Go there.
Show the elder you've left your soft ideas behind, and I'll admit you deserve a Badge.
What's the matter? Is the shrine too much to ask of you?
You've kept me waiting! Here, take this.
That's Dragon Pulse. It's... a sort of great surge of energy. You don't have to use it if you don't want to.
Aren't you off to the Pokémon League? Something in your face says you've unfinished business first.
You came from New Bark Town, didn't you, where Professor Elm's lab is? Maybe you should go back there.
Whatever comes next will be harder. Don't you dare give up, or I'll feel even worse about losing to you!
